title: Transactional Groundwater Exchange Two-Phase Commit Readiness Remediation
downstream_atomic_composition_rule: F-GC21 may prepare the accepted groundwater candidate first. If the subsequent fully prevalidated SWAP commit refuses, it must abort the groundwater reservation. Only after SWAP commit succeeds may F-GC21 invoke the no-recoverable-refusal groundwater prepared publication. Runtime ownership must prevent concurrent mutation of the same committed SWAP column or groundwater participant during this sequence.
hard_nonclaims: no networked or file-backed distributed transaction protocol
exact_head_requirement: The commit introducing this status file must itself pass the F-GC18R workflow. Only that exact green head is the final F-GC18R authority.
